text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers write new code, their teammates read it carefully before it becomes part of the project. This process helps catch bugs early, when they are easier and cheaper to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the system. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality, since everyone follows the same standards and gives helpful feedback. Although code reviews take time, they are worth the effort. They make the final product more reliable and help the whole team grow together.
